OPTION 1: S3 + CloudFront (5 websites)
RECOMMENDED
Best for: Cost-effective hosting with global CDN and full control
Cost: $15-40/month (for all 5 websites)

Key points:
- Create 5 S3 buckets (one per website) configured for static website hosting with encryption, versioning, and access logging
- CloudFront distributions in front of each S3 bucket for HTTPS, global caching, and DDoS protection with AWS Shield Standard
- Route53 for custom domain management if needed (each website can have its own domain)
- Enable S3 server access logging for compliance and monitoring
- Use AWS WAF on CloudFront for additional security (optional, adds $5-10/month per site)
- Estimated costs: S3 storage (~$0.23/month for 10GB per site), CloudFront data transfer (~$2-6/month per site depending on traffic), minimal request costs
- SOC 2 compliant with proper configuration: encryption at rest, access controls, logging enabled
- Supports custom SSL certificates via ACM (free)

Tradeoffs:
- Requires manual configuration for each website
- Need to manage S3 bucket policies and CloudFront distributions separately
- Best value for price and flexibility
